name: Pooka
gmNotes: A Pooka is an outdoor behavioural researcher who uses animal-shaped glamour for field observation and intervention. Pooka is a fey-role Archetype, not a Species, and the apparent animal is neither the Pooka's biological body nor a physical transformation. Iron and close sensory inspection can expose weak glamour. The Archetype grants no automatic mechanics.
description: A capricious spirit that wears the shape of an animal and appears on lonely roads, in fields, or at the edge of the woods. A Pooka may help, mislead, bargain, or do all three at once.
